scope: Offline only; no runtime, provider calls, restricted data or contract regeneration.

design.case: The cut pinned scope and draftIntakePartTx take case UPDATE before item/job/mapping/destination rows. ingestProvedAreaPart also takes UPDATE before preparation for direct callers.
design.binder: Plain read first; an already-bound replay takes no UPDATE. Binding rereads all original guards under UPDATE, then writes only site_id/updated_at; words, frame and revision are unchanged.
design.point2: Met by case-row serialization instead of concurrent locked publication: assertMappingTx omits mapping import/job SHARE for an open mapping. Publication can commit during off-lock preparation, but waits on case SHARE during the short locked cut, not on its mapping-job SHARE.
design.locks: Intake-large: destination advisory gate, case UPDATE, item UPDATE, own job/metadata/attempt UPDATE; draft admission then relocks case/item, shares raw import/source, recipe/profile/generation and published mapped slots; proved preparation shares source/raw import/raw slots before area/site UPDATE and package/target publication.
design.closedAndPrefix: Closed mapping admission still shares mapping import/job/raw import/source. The unchanged prefix-specific proved gate also shares mapping import/job/raw import; case UPDATE already excludes its publisher, so these cannot recreate the upgrade cycle.
design.callers: Only production proved-part caller is draftIntakePartTx. The other binder path is ingestArea; its retained-source caller service.decide owns workspace case UPDATE first. Mapping takes case SHARE before job UPDATE; commit takes case SHARE before package/area UPDATE; upload create takes case UPDATE before upload/quota rows. None requires a later case upgrade against this cut.
design.lease: Pulse after each comparePrefix raw read, rawFeatures range read, observed witness chunk, and grouped mapping raw read/payload store; draftCut pulses across pre-read stages. Existing post-read slot/source/code/access/attempt fences remain. Payload storage includes its immutable read-back.

proofs.regressions: Repository intake-cut-lock-order.test.ts executes both reproduced lock schedules, first binding and bound replay; intake-compare-lease.test.ts executes production comparePrefix/heartbeat and the actual attempt fence.

slowReads.result: Whole-file check stored; range pre-read also passes its completion fence.

proofs.mapping: 16 grouped parts, 48 storage operations including read-backs, 1104000 simulated ms, 32 pulses/24 renewals; all publish. Existing deterministic hashes, conflicts and stale-fence controls pass.
proofs.publication: Production grouped publication commits 16 parts while the cut's observed-witness storage read is paused. Its pulse runs after that read returns.

cutLock.basis: final-targeted.log open-cut scope; real admission/proof bodies with layout, processor and persistence doubles, not live PostgreSQL or a production latency guarantee

inputs.difficult: Same features replayed with duplicates/malformed member, interleaved publication/commit, changed pins and injected 23-second storage calls. Niagara/Halifax originals not opened.
